summary: Trump announced 25% tariffs on EU cars and trucks on May 1, breaking from the existing Turnberry Agreement, a move that would breach the 15% tariff ceiling laid out in the US-EU trade deal. The escalation is lifting stocks and weighing on bonds and gold, as trade uncertainty keeps real rates elevated and safe-haven demand subdued.
tweet: Trump's surprise 25% EU auto tariff tears at the Turnberry trade deal, juicing equities while bonds and gold stay under pressure as the labor market holds firm.
